scenario: LCYC.3.3.1 — the cycle-detection error message names each rule in the cycle so the author can see the loop. For a two-rule cycle between `rule_a_named` and `rule_b_named`, the DS_VALIDATE_RULE_CYCLE message contains both rule names. Pin: diagnostic quality, not just the error code.
rules_ds:
schema X scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Y scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule rule_a_named:
    X
->
    emit Y logical v: 1

rule rule_b_named:
    Y
->
    emit X logical v: 1
